design.source_policy: exclude 580 previously admitted real source hashes/paths, 36 fresh verified metadata-copy examples and 64 fresh balanced synthetic associations; fail closed on insufficient source reserve
design.router: compute current objective gradient including replay and eight current normalized protected margin gradients; probe negative objective gradient at norm .01 separately in five groups; project within each group; score negative dot of full objective gradient with projected direction, select greater predicted descent of two equal-sized transformer blocks; deterministic tie block1; all arms compute five diagnostics, random schedule seeded independently
design.optimizer: mask forbidden objective gradients before clipping, inactive shadow AdamW grad=None, actual displacement projected within selected subspace; exact inactive weight digest each trial; exact model/optimizer rollback on veto; permanently freeze embeddings and final norm in single-block arms
design.geometry: same parent-derived group metric and Euclidean cap for all arms, stage .50 -> .625 -> .75 after 5 accepted steps and 5% CE gain since last tier plus boundary crossing and exact gate, hard step .07
design.acceptance: unchanged parent-correct paired/open and historical witness retention, parent gate CE and geometry checks; additionally actual L2 step >=1e-6 and current gate CE decrease >=1e-6 on every accepted step; measure cumulative gain and report rejected tiny/no-gain steps separately
design.decision: compare dynamic vs random same active dimension and same-seed full control; final exact generation, relation both forms, old pair/open/historical losses; do not infer acquisition from gate CE alone; report routing counts, group diagnostics and expansion receipts; no promotion

limits: Router observes all five groups but chooses only between equal-sized transformer blocks to isolate selection effect; no free allocation across all groups yet
Projected gradient probe is first-order heuristic, not actual AdamW future loss or causal proof of knowledge location
All arms compute full gradients and identical diagnostic counts; optimizer and projection dimensions differ versus full control
New source and synthetic seeds, compare only within R121; limited real source reserve may block admission
Historical document cohorts reused, no independently administered blind exam; current CE gain is not exact generated answer gain
No production mutation, candidate export or promotion
